tools_attempted: PDF text extraction already present in packet
unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Local TIFF figure panels exist for supplementary biofilm figures, but no local TIFF/OCR conversion tool was available in this runtime. The text-supported P. aeruginosa values and captions were retained; unparsed per-bar values are not fabricated.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Does not block publication-grade curation because primary XML/PDF prose reports the recoverable P. aeruginosa inhibition values used in the activity layer; exact additional bar labels remain a caution only.

tools_attempted: rg over XML/PDF text for hemolysis/cytotoxicity/toxicity/viability
unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The local primary article and supplements do not report a paper-specific hemolysis/cytotoxicity assay for the three truncated analogs.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Toxicity is recorded as not reported rather than inferred from database entries that aggregate other publications.
